CustomField.description: Case assignment age is used to calculate the difference between Case assigned date and Case closed date
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISNULL(IME_SC_Resolved_Date__c)), IF(NOT( ISNULL( IME_SC_Assigned_Date__c ) ) , Text(FLOOR(IME_SC_Resolved_Date__c - IME_SC_Assigned_Date__c )) &" "&"day(s)"&" "&Text(FLOOR(MOD( (IME_SC_Resolved_Date__c - IME_SC_Assigned_Date__c ) * 24 ,24))) &" "&"hrs"&" "&Text( FLOOR(MOD(((IME_SC_Resolved_Date__c - IME_SC_Assigned_Date__c ) * 24)*60 ,60)))&" "&"min", Text(FLOOR(IME_SC_Resolved_Date__c - IME_SC_Acceptance_Date__c)) &" "&"day(s)"&" "&Text(FLOOR(MOD( (IME_SC_Resolved_Date__c - IME_SC_Acceptance_Date__c) * 24 ,24))) &" "&"hrs"&" "&Text( FLOOR(MOD(((IME_SC_Resolved_Date__c - IME_SC_Acceptance_Date__c) * 24)*60 ,60)))&" "&"min") , IF(NOT( ISNULL( IME_SC_Assigned_Date__c ) ) , Text(FLOOR( NOW() - IME_SC_Assigned_Date__c )) &" "&"day(s)"&" "&Text(FLOOR(MOD( (NOW() - IME_SC_Assigned_Date__c ) * 24 ,24))) &" "&"hrs"&" "&Text( FLOOR(MOD(((NOW() - IME_SC_Assigned_Date__c ) * 24)*60 ,60)))&" "&"min", Text(FLOOR(NOW() - IME_SC_Acceptance_Date__c)) &" "&"day(s)"&" "&Text(FLOOR(MOD( (NOW() - IME_SC_Acceptance_Date__c) * 24 ,24))) &" "&"hrs"&" "&Text( FLOOR(MOD(((NOW() - IME_SC_Acceptance_Date__c) * 24)*60 ,60)))&" "&"min") )
CustomField.label: Case Assignment Age
